facts.fact: 她一直没睡；太阳已经落过一次又升起一次——她被从自己暖和的钟楼里拖走，被迫整天整夜审问国王的囚犯。
facts.anchor: The sun had set and risen twice since I’d been dragged from my cozy clock tower and essentially put to work interrogating the Wicked King’s prisoners.

facts.fact: 每日流程：他让她评估新一批被指为叛徒或不忠的臣民，来的人来自不同国度。
facts.anchor: His Majesty would have me assess a fresh batch of suspected traitors or disloyal citizens. Various groups of people, possibly from different kingdoms across the land.

facts.fact: 遇到特别可恨的气场时，国王立刻把人带走处置。
facts.anchor: On occasion that I came across a particularly hateful aura, the king would waste no time and take them away for punishment.

facts.fact: 她总想拒绝暴露这些人的想法、感受或动机，但几乎不必开口他就已经懂了。
facts.anchor: I always tried to resist exposing these people’s thoughts, feelings, or motives, but I barely needed to speak before he would understand.

facts.fact: 有时他会在她评估之前就把人拖走；她已不再追问为什么，因为不会有满意的答案。
facts.anchor: The king would even drag away certain individuals before I had an opportunity to assess them. I had stopped asking why when it became clear I would never get any satisfactory answers.

facts.fact: 回忆：从前都是他在追求她、每次都失败——这件事曾让 Chez 与 Duchess 觉得好笑；“他”指的就是国王。
facts.anchor: He’d failed every time—much to the amusement of Chez and the Duchess.

facts.fact: 国王以一句没有商量余地的命令把对局变成任务。
结尾：她转动门把手、避开他的身体困住，逃进黑暗的走廊。
facts.anchor: Finally finding the doorknob, I turned it, quickly ducking out of his bodily cage, and slipped away into the darkened halls before my heart could explode out of my chest.
